map.顺序很关键：应先由打包器（Rollup/esbuild）做模块解析与 tree-: Order matters: first let a bundler (Rollup/esbuild) resolve modules and tree-shake, then minify the final output. If you minify each module separately first, side-effect flags and export information can be lost, keeping code that could have been dropped. Minifiers generally perform only local equivalence transforms, not cross-module analysis.
